purpose: State the minimal well-foundedness and completion conditions needed for the T5 terminal reconstruction theorem. This addendum does not alter the debt accounting rules; it makes previously implicit composition obligations explicit.

WF1_GLOBAL_OBLIGATION_OWNERSHIP.statement: At every accepted state, including portfolio/decomposed states, every original witness obligation x in X has exactly one authoritative status LIVE, DEBT, or CERTIFIED. Child/local copies are views carrying the same obligation_id and may not create additional ownership or progress.
WF1_GLOBAL_OBLIGATION_OWNERSHIP.reason: T1 partition conservation is otherwise ambiguous under DECOMPOSE/RECOMPOSE.

WF2_RECEIPT_DEPENDENCY_DAG.statement: Every projection receipt delta_E has a dependency set dep(delta_E) consisting only of B and witness obligations that were still live immediately after E was projected. The directed graph E -> dep(delta_E) intersect X is acyclic.
WF2_RECEIPT_DEPENDENCY_DAG.equivalent_operational_rule: A reconstruction rule for an earlier-projected obligation may depend only on variables that survive that projection step; later reconstruction substitutes their certified rules in reverse topological order.
WF2_RECEIPT_DEPENDENCY_DAG.reason: Prevents circular Skolem definitions from being accepted merely because each receipt is locally typed.

WF3_DISCHARGE_EXPORTS_TOTAL_COMPLETION_T.statement: Every CERTIFIED debt receipt exports a total Boolean completion term hat_f_E over its allowed dependencies. WITNESS_CERTIFIED uses its accepted witness rule. VACUITY_CERTIFIED must either (a) export a canonical completion term together with a proof that it is valid whenever the receipt premise is reachable, or (b) be globally false-domain, in which case a fixed canonical default term is recorded because the conditional witness obligation is vacuous.
WF3_DISCHARGE_EXPORTS_TOTAL_COMPLETION_T.reason: Debt status alone is insufficient to construct the total composed f_X required by T5.

WF4_LOCAL_EXTENSION_PROOF.statement: For every certified receipt delta_E with post relation R_post(Y,B), pre relation R_pre(E,Y,B), and exported completion term hat_f_E(Y,B), the checker accepts a proof of D_post(B) AND R_post(Y,B) => R_pre(hat_f_E(Y,B),Y,B), unless D_post is certified identically false, where the implication is vacuous.
WF4_LOCAL_EXTENSION_PROOF.reason: Unifies witness and vacuity discharge into one semantic extension invariant used by reconstruction.

WF5_EXACT_TRANSITION_DOMAIN_PRESERVATION.statement: REVERSIBLE_NORMALIZE preserves represented relation up to checked isomorphism; PROJECT proves R_post(Y,B) iff exists E R_pre(E,Y,B); DECOMPOSE/RECOMPOSE carry an exact recomposition theorem. Therefore each accepted semantic transition preserves the external domain D(B).
WF5_EXACT_TRANSITION_DOMAIN_PRESERVATION.reason: T5 must produce a Skolem map on the original exact domain D0, not merely on a terminal approximation.

WF6_RECOMPOSITION_COMPATIBILITY.statement: When multiple child states are recomposed, shared live variables, shared debt obligations and certified completion terms must agree under the exact recomposition contract. Duplicate obligation_ids are deduplicated by provenance and may not be certified twice.
WF6_RECOMPOSITION_COMPATIBILITY.reason: Prevents inconsistent child witnesses or double-counted debt progress.

WF7_TERMINAL_CLOSURE.statement: An open-interface terminal is admissible only when V_live=empty, V_debt=empty, every projection receipt in Omega is certified and exports a completion term, the receipt dependency graph is acyclic, all recomposition obligations are closed, and the terminal exact domain certificate is present.
WF7_TERMINAL_CLOSURE.reason: These are the exact hypotheses under which reverse composition is a well-defined total f_X(B).

clarification_of_vacuity.unsafe_old_reading: A statement that 'choice is irrelevant' without a completion term or false-domain proof could mark an obligation CERTIFIED while leaving no constructible f_X.
clarification_of_vacuity.safe_reading: Vacuity is a proof class, not absence of reconstruction data. It must still export a canonical completion term unless the relevant exact domain is identically false.

collision_certificate_boundary.negative_role: A found semantic collision rejects a proposed reversible normalization.
collision_certificate_boundary.positive_role: No collision found is not a bijection certificate; REVERSIBLE_NORMALIZE still requires an independently checkable positive isomorphism/bijection proof.

effect_on_theorem_targets.T1: Provable under WF1 and transition typing.
effect_on_theorem_targets.T3: Provable directly for PROJECT on previously-live obligation ids.
effect_on_theorem_targets.T5: Provable under WF1-WF7 by reverse topological composition plus exact-domain preservation.

nonclaims: The dependency DAG or completion terms can always be found efficiently.
The transition system is complete for arbitrary Boolean functional synthesis.
The resulting proof objects are polynomial size on every instance.
The scheduler can find a terminating sequence.
P=NP or general SAT is in P.
